title: Treaty of Speyer (1570)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Speyer (1570)", at revision 1377703353, opens: "The Treaty of Speyer, signed at the Diet of Speyer in 1570, was a peace agreement between the two Hungarian Kingdoms, Royal Hungary led by Maximilian II, and the Eastern Hungarian Kingdom, ruled by John Sigismund Zápolya, which led to the establishment of the Principality of Transylvania." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q836424, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1570 treaty in Transylvania". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
